command:
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
Write-Host "===== SQUASH BOOKMARKS TO MAIN ====="
git fetch origin main work/bookmarks-winui --no-tags --prune
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "git fetch failed" }
$expectedMain="5228cbbfc24f56d61a84975545f1d8572e7deece"
$expectedWork="914330516cd5e3c7fe9827600cb546345785c288"
if ((git rev-parse origin/main).Trim() -ne $expectedMain) { throw "main moved" }
if ((git rev-parse origin/work/bookmarks-winui).Trim() -ne $expectedWork) { throw "work branch moved" }
$status=@(git status --short)
if($status.Count -ne 0){$status|%{Write-Host $_};throw "unexpected local changes"}

git checkout main
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "checkout main failed" }
git merge --ff-only origin/main
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "main fast-forward failed" }
git merge --squash origin/work/bookmarks-winui
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "squash merge failed" }

Write-Host "STAGED_FILES"
git diff --cached --name-status
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "staged diff listing failed" }
git diff --cached --check
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "staged diff check failed" }

$expectedFiles=@(
"app/winui/MainWindow.xaml",
"app/winui/MainWindow.xaml.cpp",
"app/winui/MainWindow.xaml.h",
"app/winui/bookmark_features.cpp",
"app/winui/flyExplorer.project-template.xml",
"app/winui/m19_features.cpp",
"docs/development/CURRENT_STATUS.md",
"src/base/bookmark_store.cpp",
"src/base/bookmark_store.h",
"tests/winui/m20/FlyM20StateContracts.project-template.xml",
"tests/winui/m20/m20_native_fixture.cpp",
"tests/winui/m20/test_native.py",
"tests/winui/test_bookmark_contract.py",
"tests/winui/test_bookmark_gui.py",
"tools/winui/run_checks.py"
)
$actual=@(git diff --cached --name-only)
$missing=@($expectedFiles | Where-Object { $_ -notin $actual })
$extra=@($actual | Where-Object { $_ -notin $expectedFiles })
if($missing.Count -or $extra.Count){
 Write-Host "MISSING=$($missing -join ',')"
 Write-Host "EXTRA=$($extra -join ',')"
 throw "staged scope mismatch"
}

git -c user.name="YoungMin Jeon" -c user.email="126930369+tngkrwlsmd@users.noreply.github.com" commit -m "feat: add persistent WinUI bookmarks" -m "CI-Scope: release-gui"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "commit failed" }
$newHead=(git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
Write-Host "NEW_MAIN_HEAD=$newHead"
git push origin main
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "push main failed" }
git fetch origin main --no-tags
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "post-push fetch failed" }
$originMain=(git rev-parse origin/main).Trim()
if($originMain -ne $newHead){throw "origin/main does not match pushed HEAD"}
$counts=@((git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...origin/main).Trim() -split "\s+")
Write-Host "AHEAD_BEHIND=$($counts -join '/')"
if($counts.Count -ne 2 -or $counts[0] -ne "0" -or $counts[1] -ne "0"){throw "main ahead/behind is not zero"}
Write-Host "BOOKMARK_MAIN_PUSH_PASS"
